drawRectTooltip: Click and drag to draw a rectangle
helpStep1: Draw a selection: click the rectangle icon in the map toolbar (top-right) and drag to mark an area.
helpStep2: Set criteria: use the sliders to control minimum elevation, max slope, peak closeness, valley depth, and peak prominence.
helpStep3: Click "Analyze Area" — terrain data is fetched and analyzed entirely in your browser.
helpStep4: Explore results: directional markers show viewpoints on the map. Click a marker or result card for details.
helpStep5: Save favourites: use ❤️ Love or ⭐ Star buttons to bookmark spots across sessions.
helpStep6: Access warning: viewpoints may be near or on private property. Do not enter private land without permission, and stay on legal public access routes.
helpCreditsMap: Map data and basemaps are provided by OpenStreetMap, OpenTopoMap, and Esri.
helpCreditsGeocoding: Reverse geocoding is provided by OpenStreetMap contributors via Nominatim.
helpCreditsTerrainSources: Terrain sources include ArcticDEM, Geoscience Australia, Austria's DGM, Canada's CDEM, Copernicus EU-DEM, NOAA ETOPO1, INEGI, LINZ, Kartverket, the UK Environment Agency, and USGS 3DEP/GMTED2010/SRTM. Full source attribution: {{attribution}}.
helpCreditsIcons: Some UI icons are adapted from {{silk}} under {{license}}.
